capture.hint: Type to capture. Tab and Shift+Tab change the type.
capture.keys: Enter saves · Shift+Enter saves and stays · Tab/Shift+Tab type · /t timer · /p pomodoro · Esc closes

error.needs-date-time: Events need a date and time (e.g. fri 3pm)
error.khal-failed: khal could not create the event
error.unknown-command: Unknown command. Use /p, /p focus, /p short, /p long or /p stop

placeholders.task: Buy bread tomorrow 9h (no date means today)
placeholders.event: Meeting friday 15h-16h (needs a date and time)
placeholders.reminder: Pay the bill tomorrow 18h (needs a time)
placeholders.note: An idea or a quick note
placeholders.link: Paste an https://... link to read later

capture.not-ready: Daybar is still starting. Try again in a moment.

today.title: Today
today.add-placeholder: New task for today. E.g.: call the bank 3pm
today.empty-title: A free day. How about planning something?

calendar.not-configured: Calendar not configured. Install khal and vdirsyncer (see README).
calendar.weekdays: S M T W T F S

focus.toast-work-done: Focus session complete. Time for a break.
focus.settings-help: Changes apply right away to a cycle that has not started. A goal of 0 turns the daily goal off.

agenda.sync-failed-body: The event was saved locally and will sync on the next run.

store.corrupt-body: The old file was kept as data.json.bak and a new one was started.
store.imported: Imported {tasks} tasks, {notes} notes and {bookmarks} bookmarks from the previous version.

daily_pomodoro_goal.label: Daily pomodoro goal (0 turns it off)

focus_mode_command.label: Focus mode command
focus_mode_command.description: Executable called with on/off when a focus session starts or stops. Leave empty to disable.

default_calendar.label: Default calendar
default_calendar.description: Calendar for new events and reminders. Must match a name from khal printcalendars; empty uses the khal default.

fetch_previews.label: Fetch link previews
fetch_previews.description: When a bookmark is saved, download the page's title, description and image.

bookmarks.title: Bookmarks
bookmarks.add-placeholder: Paste an https://... link and press Enter
bookmarks.empty: Paste a link in the field below or use quick capture.

notes.title: Notes
notes.empty: Create a note or use /n in quick capture.
notes.keys: Ctrl+E edit/preview · Ctrl+S save · Esc close

events.confirm-delete-recurring: This event repeats. Delete all occurrences?

error.title: Calendar
error.failed: Could not delete the event file

timer.entry-help: Enter starts. From quick capture: /t 10m tea
